ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Binary In User Directory Spawned From Office Application
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects an executable in the users directory started from one of the Microsoft Office suite applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Publisher, Visio)

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\WINWORD\\\.EXE$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\EXCEL\\\.EXE$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\POWERPNT\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\MSPUB\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\VISIO\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\MSACCESS\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\EQNEDT32\\\.exe$")) AND process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\users\\\\") AND process_path = RGX("\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\Teams\\\.exe$"))
